items.q: it's Harmon and he has another company, and I wrote all of what you call the Gigin gigin series, made stock arrangements.

ctx.x: Well, it's Harmon and he has another company, and I wrote all of what you call the Gigin gigin series, made stock arrangements. I used to make stock arrangements for Benny Goodman's company. When he had the group with Teddy Wilson and Charlie Christian, and some of the Fletcher Henderson things I wrote those and made stock arrangements out of them. They called it gigin series like with eight pieces. And --
Was there any one tune in that series?
